ety.text: Related to Lithuanian kiáuras, Latvian саũrs, Lithuanian kiùrstu, kiuraũ, kiùrti, skiaurė̃, Middle High German schore. Less likely Polish szczur (“rat”). Inherited from Proto-Slavic *čurъ or *ščurъ from Proto-Indo-European *(s)kew-. The pejorative sense of "Caucasian or Central Asian immigrant", while being a semantic narrowing of the word used towards dumb people in general, may have been influenced phonetically by words like чёрный (čórnyj, “black”) and -ка (-ka, “little”), referring to some immigrants' darker skin tones, or by черке́с (čerkés).
